name: The Green Accord
tagline: A forest and a village can share a road.
description: Lead Alder’s woodland pack against an illegal logging operation. Capture its camps, uncover the missing workers’ fate, and bring the evidence to the village council across the river.

ending.speaker: Lark
ending.text: The first cart crossed today. It carried apples, not axes.

ending.speaker: Alder
ending.text: Keep the road open. The roots will do the rest.
